enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Scratch arm. Turn again. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Stretch arms. Turn off alarm clock. Walk to bedroom door. Open door. Walk out of bedroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Apply soap to face. Rinse face with water. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Put toothbrush down. Turn off faucet. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and spoon. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Put bowl and spoon in sink. Wipe mouth with napkin. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Open closet. Select shirt and pants. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Put phone in bag. Pick up keys. Turn off light. Exit bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Get on bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone messages. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into work clothes. Walk to department.

enriched_activities.activity: working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient schedule. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Write notes in chart. Walk to nurses station. Use computer to update records. Answer phone. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Return to station. Talk to colleague. Walk to next patient room.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to department.

enriched_activities.activity: working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check messages. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Perform assessment. Administer treatment. Document in chart. Walk to supply room. Retrieve supplies. Walk to another patient room. Assist patient with mobility. Talk to family member. Update care plan. Use computer to order tests. Consult with therapist. Attend team meeting. Return to station. Prepare for handover.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Get on bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read news. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter building. Walk to apartment door. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: washing hands and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off faucet. Dry hands with towel. Take off work clothes. Put on casual clothes. Put work clothes in laundry basket. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables and meat. Stir with spatula. Cook for 15 minutes. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table.

Scrape food scraps into trash. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch show. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Continue watching TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Turn off TV. Stand up. Turn off light. Exit living room.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Put phone on charger. Set alarm. Open book. Read book. Close book. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Adjust pillow.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Scratch leg. Turn again. Sleep.
